scope: in-process BFV-to-two-additive-shares reference, exact x^2+3x+7 in F_65537, one ciphertext pair per island
backend: TenSEAL BFV, degree 4096, 65537 plaintext modulus, explicit relinearization keys, one worker thread
roles: A owns BFV secret key and input share; B receives public context and ciphertext and owns independent input share plus fresh uniform output mask; B returns only masked encrypted output; A decrypts only its output share

existing_he_authenticated_triple_check.interpretation: Existing BFV batching generates ordinary independent one-use authenticated triples, not a compact reusable correlated seed. One multiplication per bottleneck element is only an optimistic illustrative gate, not a SiLU or full-decoder cost.

matched_control_reference: docs/evidence/latent-response-network-qwen25-2026-09-28.json; real prepared Qwen2.5 W8A8 39+8 and 39+32 covered all-link bodies, not measured HE decoder execution
qualifications: The 8/32-island measurements are sequential independent bounded inputs with one context reused, not dependent autoregressive model execution. The 24-layer body multiplication is a byte-count projection, not a measured decoder.
39 one-token-shaped rows pack into one BFV island, but future autoregressive rows cannot be batched without new private token feedback.
The exact quadratic field operation has no SiLU, BF16, rounding, truncation, decoder-activation range, or real-checkpoint quality parity.
Public context is distributed once per local probe, not included in online-only counts; cold covered counts add it once. Secret-key storage and process startup are not full model distribution costs.
Peak RSS is process-lifetime peak, not marginal HE allocation; all roles share one Python process, no external operator privacy or full TLS/control wire metering.

Honest-execution reference only: no malicious-evaluator output proof, reviewed cryptographic security contract, authenticated network protocol, share-resident tensor schedule or production role admission.

Existing BFV authenticated-triple batching is measured separately and requires distribution of each fresh triple; no compact correlated seed or multi-gate compressed material is implemented. One small encrypted polynomial evaluation cannot be counted as savings on one-use key distribution.
